title: docs: document the unit-code backfill door (os migrate unit-codes and its REST twin)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8ZBQe4UHadd2fGHGeWRW9V)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Fixes #35868

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:运维与租户管理员在文档站能读到「把已存的自由文本单位换成单位代码」的命令与接口说明,并新增一页「计量单位」;功能本身不变。
- 为什么做:单位保存被拒时提示里点名的修复命令,文档此前只字未提;属于计量单位(单位代码)这条线的文档补齐。
- 出错会怎样:只影响文档与一段配置项说明文字,写错只会误导读者,可随时撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: a row for `os migrate unit-codes` in the `os migrate` table, and a new `os migrate unit-codes` section beside `os migrate record-currency-codes` — dry-run (no mapping, then with mapping) and apply examples, the mapping file shape with the `""` entry for a blank unit beside a quantity, the `--org` / `--all-organizations` scope rule, what is never rewritten, and the REST twin `POST /api/v1/meta/_migrate-unit-codes` (body, preview posture, 403s, the maintenance switch). Every claim measured against `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/unit-codes.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/unit-code-backfill.ts` and `packages/rest/src/meta-unit-code-backfill-route.ts` at 98bda0ac.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/units.mdx` (new, listed in `meta.json` after `currency` and in the section's landing index): the three `unitConfig` modes, and "Converting a field that already holds rows" — the two 409 findings, the dry run, the mapping, `--apply` — linking the CLI section. Overlap check (A3): no data-modeling page explained units or `unitConfig` (`field-types.mdx`, `fields.mdx`, `field-type-decision-tree.mdx`: zero `unitConfig` hits), so a new page beside `currency.mdx`.
- `packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts`: the `metadata.endpoints.maintenance` describe names `POST /meta/_migrate-unit-codes` beside the currency door (the route already registers behind that switch, and `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts` already pins it). `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx` regenerated by `check:generated --fix` (only `check:docs` was stale). Patch changeset for `@objectstack/spec`.

## Acceptance notes

- The card names the findings `unit_mode_to_record` and `unit_mode_to_code`; main raises `unit_mode_to_record` and `unit_code_field_declared` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-write-face.ts`). The docs follow the code.
- No SDK method exists for the unit door (no `migrateUnitCodes` in `packages/client/src`), so unlike the currency section there is no SDK example.
- **Open fence item:** adding the page makes `pnpm check:docs-audit-scope` red: `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json` must list `content/docs/data-modeling/units.mdx` (one generated line, `node scripts/docs-audit/check-audit-scope.mjs --write`). That path is outside the claim's file surface, so it is not in this PR; it waits for the seat's word.

## Tests

<details><summary>Local runs at 9ec53fc0</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` → VERDICT command-exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → 1 of 14 stale (`check:docs`), fixed with `--fix`, rest-server.mdx 1 line
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` + `vitest run src/api/rest-server.test.ts` → Test Files 1 passed, Tests 53 passed
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 104 families; all run; `--ran` reconciliation 104/104. Red: `check:docs-audit-scope` (the fence item above). Not measured locally (exit 3, prerequisite: whole-workspace build): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:skill-examples`, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow clone) — CI runs them. After building the lint closure: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:docs-transcript-drift` exit 0.
- `overlap-check --branch=HEAD` → clean against origin/main and #37314.

</details>

## Verification

Read first: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (the new section; risk: a claim that drifts from the command), `content/docs/data-modeling/units.mdx`.
Two-minute check: `git grep -n "_migrate-unit-codes" -- packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts content/docs` shows the describe, its reference row, the CLI section and the units page.
